pages.text: Some respawn mechanics have been changed in this pack.$(br2)When you set your spawn point using a $(item)bed$(), that spawn point will remain even if the bed is destroyed! Solid blocks and water will still obstruct it.$(br2)Despite this, $(thing)insomnia$() is disabled, so don't worry about phantoms!

Additionally, your spawn point will be set to most $(item)portals$() when you use them. This doesn't apply to the End portal. If you set up a base, you'll probably want to set your spawn point whenever you return.$(br2)Lastly, if you respawn too close to the Wither Storm, your respawn point will be temporarily moved a few hundred blocks further away.
